description: This file defines a helper class `ModuleScreenHelper` that provides static methods for retrieving and resetting the current module and screen information based on HTTP request data within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with request stack services and manages a singleton `ModuleScreen` instance.

classes.name: ModuleScreenHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods to retrieve or reset the current module and screen based on the HTTP request. Implements singleton pattern for ModuleScreen instance.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current module and screen by parsing the request path. Caches the result in a static property.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Fetches the current HTTP request object from the request stack service.

methods.name: resetCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Resets the cached ModuleScreen instance to null.
